## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.4

This release updates the rune GUI presentation and screen-local typography while retaining the v1.1.3 gameplay logic.

### Added

- Added Five / Seven fonts for this GUI, including Cyrillic support, without replacing Minecraft's global font.
- Added the final Full, Wide and Compact runtime screenshots and synchronized resource-pack documentation.
- Added font provenance, the Cristalix support correspondence and the recorded noncommercial integration scope.

### Fixed

- Restored the intended panel, statistics, resource, navigation and rune-grid presentation from the archived GUI implementation.
- Restored pixel-drawn icons, rank overlays, disabled-button text and two-line purchase/upgrade labels.

### Other

- Preserved inventory, purchase, awakening, server, network and MongoDB behavior.
- Passed the local build, inventory/catalog regression checks and CI.
- Recorded manual verification of GUI scaling, search, purchases, awakening and blur cleanup. Foreign shaders, unsupported hardware and font-cache stress were outside that manual pass.
- Retained original font metadata. The support correspondence records a qualified decision for the described noncommercial project, not a general or commercial font license; other permission-pending client assets remain excluded.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.4.jar`. The client and server must use the same mod version.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`

[Font provenance and support record](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/blob/v1.1.4/docs/permissions/cristalix.md).

**Full Changelog:** [v1.1.3...v1.1.4](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.1.3...v1.1.4)
